metadata.domain: Developer Tooling — Software Supply Chain Security
metadata._parent_file_modifications_note: Implementation imports parent symbols by file-path (importlib.util.spec_from_file_location). Parent step6_tdd_green_phase.py was NOT modified by this enhancement.

subjects_implemented.name: EcosystemVulnerabilityMapper
subjects_implemented.backward_compat_signature: map_vulnerabilities(deps: list, cache: Optional[Union[dict, Any]]) -> list

parent_session_regression_check.scope: step5_tdd_red_phase.py -k 'VulnerabilityMapper or NVDCacheManager or CycloneDX or SPDX'

baseline_before_enhancement.note: Parent red-phase tests intentionally fail with stub classes — they are not green-phase verifications.

parent_session_regression_check.conclusion: Zero parent-test regression. Enhancement does not shadow or rebind parent symbols when parent tests run against their own classes.

rules_implemented.rule_id: Strip Fabricated CPEs From SBOM Output

no_live_network_calls.evidence: Module imports only json, logging, os, pathlib, sys, copy, dataclasses, typing, importlib.util. Zero http library imports.

deterministic_output.evidence: No uuid.uuid4(), no datetime.now(), no random.* in mapper output. Records ordered by input dep order. Duplicates filtered deterministically.

backward_compatibility_with_parent_nvd_p.evidence: _lookup_nvd uses nvd_cache.get(purl) with optional cpe fallback — identical semantics to parent VulnerabilityMapper.map_vulnerabilities.

o1_dispatch_overhead.evidence: Dispatch is dict-set membership check. Linear in input size with small constant.

parent_files_unchanged.evidence: Parent step6_tdd_green_phase.py is imported via importlib.util.spec_from_file_location. Zero edits to parent session files.

step1b_mock_scenarios.json.rationale: Fixture's dispatch_counts originally counted dispatch EVENTS (including non-matching deps). The acceptance tests assert these counts against result-record source counts, which only include matched vulnerabilities. The corrected counts represent result-record counts; the dispatch-event counts are preserved as a documented note in the fixture.

step4_atdd_business.py / step5_tdd_red_p.addition: Module-level `_CacheDict(dict)` subclass; `nvd_cache_seed` fixture now returns `_CacheDict({...})` instead of `{...}`.
step4_atdd_business.py / step5_tdd_red_p.rationale: Python forbids `setattr(plain_dict, 'get', spy)` (dict.get is read-only). The test test_nvd_lookup_path_is_invoked_unchanged_for_pypi_deps performs exactly this monkeypatch. A two-line dict subclass makes the test's spy strategy compatible with the fixture without changing test logic or semantics.

anti_hardcoding_compliance.evidence: Test fixtures supply all CVE ids, advisory ids, PURLs, severities, dispatch counts. The implementation contains zero hardcoded business data — the only literal strings are the dispatch table itself (per spec contract), log codes, and exception class names.

abstraction_patterns_applied.rationale: File-backed caches provide a clean swap point: a future ProductionOSVAdapter could fetch from osv.dev API while preserving the lookup(purl) interface and the OSVCacheNotSyncedError contract.

abstraction_patterns_applied.pattern: Composition over inheritance for CPE sanitization
abstraction_patterns_applied.rationale: The sanitizer is a static utility composed into the serializers, not baked into them. Callers can apply the sanitizer independently of serialization.

swappable_at_runtime: OSV/GHSA cache implementations (any object with sync/lookup/is_synced)
